product_one_liner.value: Fundraise Up is an AI-powered online donation and fundraising platform for nonprofit organizations, designed to improve donor conversion, recurring giving, payments, and fundraising revenue.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page describes $0 upfront, no setup fees, no annual subscription cost, and an approximately 1% average effective Fundraise Up cost.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index is primarily product, fundraising, and news/knowledge content; it does not show the required two-post engineering/technical blog.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site contains guides for onboarding, campaigns, analytics, APIs, integrations, security, and more.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-role list includes Head Of Data but no role title containing AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied scientist, research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision.

model_provider.notes: The Trust Center lists Anthropic as a subprocessor for AI processing supporting Agentic Giving and platform features.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center lists SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS documents; no claim for HIPAA or GDPR was included in this list.

last_funding.notes: The January 2025 round was described as a minority growth investment led by Summit Partners; Fundraise Up's careers page identifies the company as Series B funded.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was January 2025, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers list includes Account Executive, Education Vertical.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog index lists the product launch 'Introducing Sponsorships' dated 2026-11-02, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small leadership roster is readable in full and shows no dated C-level or VP join/leave event inside the 12-month window; no departure is announced there.
